explication: agentOS is an embeddable operating system for coding agents. A host application creates an AgentOS VM, opens an ACP-backed session, and sends prompts or commands; the sidecar coordinates an isolated executor with permissions, processes, language runtimes, and mounted filesystems, then streams transcript and command results back. The tree also documents cron, bindings, persistence, actor deployment, browser execution, and external storage mounts. Several internal links are inferred from explicit module responsibilities because only partial source excerpts were provided.
